title: Agent Handoff Context
hints: Make one pass to decide which tool call ids survive: calls on non-private assistant turns whose tool the specialist has.
A tool message survives only if its tool_call_id is in that set. Otherwise the specialist sees a result for a call it never made.
Filter tool_calls on a copy. If none are left, delete the key, and drop the turn entirely when it has no content either.
Build the carried list first, then use it both for the summarizer call and for the final transcript, so the summarizer never sees the scratchpad.
